thread:
leo_cs: Heads-up from NovoLegal - theyre running a partner showcase on 2024-11-15 and need a short allowlist + regional QPS bump for US-WEST and EU-WEST.
kai_netops: What QPS numbers are they asking for? Any CIDRs yet?
leo_cs: Theyre asking to go from 150 -> 600 qps for 6 hours only. CIDRs:
- 198.51.100.64/26
- 203.0.113.128/25
Requested window: 2024-11-15T14:00Z -> 2024-11-15T20:00Z. They also want us to open outbound to eu-west-1 for peered demo infra.
sam_platform: 600 qps is large for a short window; we need to check regional caps and if any other accounts are using reserved peering. Ivy, can SRE confirm peering availability in eu-west-1 and us-west-2?
ivy_sre: On it. I'll validate peering and schedule rollback at window end. Also will add temporary ingest alert.
cron-bot: Stub change request created: CR-5129 for account 881004 by leo_cs. Scheduled 2024-11-15T14:00Z - 2024-11-15T20:00Z.
sam_platform: Draft API patch Ill run at start time:

PATCH /admin/accounts/881004/limits
{
  "qps": 600,
  "regions": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"]
}

sam_platform: Ill also attach the allowlist entries and tag CR-5129 so ops can trace.
kai_netops: Quick check: us-west-2 peering has 1 spare slot, eu-west-1 currently at 0 spare slots but one will free up after a scheduled job at 2024-11-15T12:30Z. If that job slips we need fallback to edge-proxy.
ivy_sre: Confirmed: peering job is green. Provisioning route now, BGP will be flapped briefly during the change. Ill post rollback steps.
ivy_sre: Rollback plan:
- Remove temporary CIDRs
- Restore qps to 150
- Verify no leftover routes
If any errors, escalate to eng-oncall.
leo_cs: Customer asked for auto-revoke immediately after the window and an audit log entry they can share with their security team.
sam_platform: Auto-revoke scheduled at 2024-11-15T20:05Z and audit notes added to CR-5129. Ill also export the change diff for them.
kai_netops: Applying changes now at 2024-11-15T14:01Z. Adding CIDRs and increasing qps. Monitoring net metrics.
cron-bot: Change CR-5129: status=applied at 2024-11-15T14:02Z.
ivy_sre: No packet loss observed after route add. BGP flapped for ~20s.
sam_platform: Added temporary alert: request_rate > 700 -> page eng-oncall. Dashboard updated with NovoLegal stream view.
leo_cs: Customer reports demo traffic looks good. Latency within expected range. They requested we keep a small post-demo window (30m) to collect logs.
ivy_sre: Kept bump for +30m, auto-revoke still scheduled for 2024-11-15T20:05Z. Logging verification in PD ticket.
sam_platform: Revoke executed at 2024-11-15T20:05Z. Limits restored and CIDRs removed.
cron-bot: Change CR-5129: status=closed at 2024-11-15T20:07Z.
leo_cs: Thanks all. Ill add a short note to NovoLegals onboarding doc and flag renewal health as positive after a successful demo. :white_check_mark:
ivy_sre: One note for runbook: if eu-west peering is full, fallback to single-region failover plus compressed responses to keep costs down.
leo_cs: Closing thread. Great work. :tada:
